name: agent-manager
description: See the coding agents on your computer, install and update them, and give them to your rooms. Nothing is installed or changed until you click.

settings.label: Agents offered
settings.help: Agent ids members may install and update, one per line (such as gemini). Empty offers the whole catalog.

settings.label: Pinned versions
settings.help: One <agent id>@<version> per line (such as gemini@0.65.0). A pinned agent is offered and installed at that version only; an install that cannot be set to a chosen version gets no update.

settings.label: Hold new versions for (days)
settings.help: A version published more recently than this is not offered yet. Empty offers the newest.

settings.label: Update the agents this app installed automatically
settings.help: When on, an agent this app installed is updated as soon as a newer version is offered. Agents you installed yourself are never updated without a click.

settings.label: More agents to recognise
settings.help: Agents to recognise, each a JSON object (one line or several): {"id":"corp","name":"Corp CLI","command":"corp","versionArgs":["--version"]}. A command name and one version flag only; no install or update command, no ACP launch line. See the README.

settings.label: My own agents
settings.help: Agents for this computer, each a JSON object (one line or several): id, name, command (name or path), versionArgs, versionParse, installArgs (+installCommand), updateArgs (+updateCommand), acpArgs. Install and update show their command and run on your click. See the README.
